text:
Ari Tran: quick heads-up 1: I'm prepping a docs PR to fix reserved-pool tagging guidance and update the terraform variable mapping note. small cleanup, but optics matter for onboarding.
Joel Rivera: Awesome. What's the terraform rename again? I remember a rename last quarter that broke some infra repos.
Ari Tran: old: `reserved_pool` -> new: `reserved_capacity`. Also the module now requires `labels = {}` and `reservation = true|false`. I'll add a migration snippet.
Maya Singh: Can you include a short CLI example for folks who use the `redwoodctl` CLI? People skip SDKs sometimes.
Ari Tran: Yup. Draft CLI + terraform snippets incoming. Also found a broken anchor in the quota matrix page: /docs/provisioning#quota-matrix--reserved. I'll patch link targets too.
Tom Brooks: For the docs text, please avoid the word "guarantee" in SLA lines. Legal prefers "aim for" or "target".
Ari Tran: noted. I'll change the SLA line to: "Target uptime for Dedicated reserved capacity is 99.9% (measured per calendar month)."
Maya Singh: Example CLI snippet looks good, but show env var usage and a JSON payload option.
Ari Tran: here's the CLI + terraform migration example I'm planning to include:
```bash
# create reserved capacity via CLI
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... 
redwoodctl capacity create \
  --tenant tenant-42 \
  --name "reserved-gpu-a" \
  --labels workload=llm,isolation=reserved \
  --reservation true
```
```hcl
# migration: terraform v2 -> v3
module "capacity" {
  source = "git::.../terraform-capacity?ref=v3"

  tenant_id        = var.tenant_id
  reserved_capacity = var.reserved_capacity_count  # was reserved_pool
  labels           = var.labels  # new explicit field
  reservation      = var.reservation  # new boolean
}
```
Joel Rivera: Nice. Can you add a one-line note about preemption behavior for reserved pools vs shared? People ask this.
Ari Tran: I'll add: "Reserved pools minimize preemption; in rare burst scenarios additional capacity may be fulfilled from shared pools and could incur higher tail latency."
Priya Nair: I can help with link checks and staging health. Ping me when PR is open.
Ari Tran: will do. Also planning to add a tiny diagram showing label flow: tenant -> label -> routing -> reserved pool. Might be an inline SVG.
Tom Brooks: Please include a quick rollback command if someone needs to flip `reservation=false` quickly.
Ari Tran: good call. Add CLI quick rollback example too.
Maya Singh: One more ask: point out that older SDKs (<v1.8) accept `tenant_labels` instead of `labels`. Put that in a migration note.

Joel Rivera: small nit: change `reserved_capacity` var name in the hcl comment to `reserved_count` to match module inputs.
Ari Tran: fixed. pushing update now.

Ari Tran: merged and deployed to staging. Posting staging link in PR. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
